HUD Layout Guide

Choose a control style and follow a practical placement guide

2-finger layout

Beginner-friendly setup. Keep movement on the left and aim/fire controls on the right. Place jump, crouch and scope buttons within comfortable thumb reach.

  • Left thumb: movement joystick
  • Right thumb: aim, fire, scope and actions
  • Adjust button size and opacity to your comfort

HUD suggestions are starting points, not universal settings. Adjust them to your hand size and device.

🎯

Headshot Training

A repeatable practice routine for improving aim consistency

Ⅰ

Warm-up · 5 min

Track moving targets and practise smooth crosshair movement before increasing speed.

Ⅱ

Drag practice · 10 min

Practise controlled upward drag with short bursts. Focus on consistency rather than speed.

Ⅲ

Strafe practice · 5 min

Move side-to-side while keeping your crosshair near upper-body level.

Ⅳ

Review · 5 min

Notice missed shots, over-dragging and uncomfortable controls. Change one setting at a time.

Daily practice checklist




Training advice only. No macro, script, injector or gameplay automation is provided.

About the Founder

Toyash Sinsinwar is the founder and web developer of GWT Creations. He works on shaping the website experience, maintaining its features and helping the platform grow. His goal is to make useful, creative and easy-to-use tools for the gaming community.
